reason: BLS returned no October 2025 unemployment rate. The Sahm look-back includes that month, so no threshold was calculated. The September 2026 rate 4.2 is the published baseline only.

missing_observation.footnote: Data unavailable due to the 2025 lapse in appropriations.

schedule_note: https://www.bls.gov/schedule/news_release/empsit.htm returned an access-denied page on 18 October 2026. The 6 November 2026 13:30 UTC instant is the previously reported Eastern 08:30 release and is not marked verified.
statement: No directional unemployment-rate forecast was made.
